query:
SELECT title_id AS "title_id!", array_agg(property || ':' || item) AS "facts!",
                  array_agg(sharing) AS "sharing!"
           FROM (SELECT title_id, property, item,
                        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY property, item) AS sharing
                 FROM title_facts) AS facts
           WHERE sharing > 1
           GROUP BY title_id
